name: training-plan
description: Generate customized learning paths using Test-Teach-Test methodology with integrated concept-builder pedagogy. Decompose goals into Core Principles (foundational truths with worked examples) and Key Concepts (operational knowledge), design sessions, run interactive TTT loops with principle-first teaching (LaTeX, fully developed worked examples, CTQ mastery criteria, concept maps, comparison, deep-dive), concept file export, and a concept library. Each plan opens with an editable Motivation & Course Overview (VOC) bird's-eye view whose feedback can restructure the plan, and maintains an Artefacts Register anchoring every artefact sessions produce. Built for difficult subjects: every plan is pitched at a target level (High school, Master's or Advanced), carries five required elements (core principles, key facts, motivation, breakthrough, method), and flags its hard-core principles, which are taught through an aha moment and a climb through the levels with fully worked exercises, in sessions, in the plan, in an exercise book and on demand. Also ships an accessory skill, technical-training-manual, that writes a PDF technical training manual on any subject in US corporate-manual style. Includes Socratic Discovery mode (Question-Tension-Resolution-Test arc with Socratic Guidance Chains), mid-session checkpointing, persistent learner profiles, and cross-plan analytics.
